verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Justworks has an Analytics > Custom Payroll Report used to check payroll data, implying reporting capability exists, but there's no explicit documentation of generating a payroll register or gross-to-net report specifically, nor any mention of export formats (CSV/PDF/Excel) for analysis.
